nodes.label: Temporal Graph Attention Network (TGAT) Continuous-Time Embedding Kernel
nodes.description: Continuous-time dynamic graph neural network using self-attention over continuous time-encoded node interactions to learn time-aware node representations.

nodes.label: W3C SPARQL 1.1 Query Language & Protocol Specification

nodes.label: Multilingual BERT Cross-Lingual Arabic Entity Linking Model

nodes.label: SLH-DSA / SPHINCS+ Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Protocol
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 205 post-quantum stateless hash-based digital signature standard providing cryptographic authentication for sovereign graph kernel binaries and state snapshot payloads.

nodes.label: PCIe 6.0 Flow Layer Packet (FLIT) Direct Interconnect Bus Architecture
nodes.description: High-throughput PAM4 64 GT/s interconnect architecture utilizing fixed-size 256-byte FLITs with low-latency Forward Error Correction (FEC) for hardware-accelerated graph memory fabric.
